meta.title: INC-77 postmortem
meta.reference: INC-77: checkout API errors on Oct 14 from 09:12 to 09:58 UTC (46 minutes). About 3,100 checkouts failed. The paging alert fired at 09:20 UTC and was acknowledged at 09:31 UTC. Root cause: the TLS certificate on the internal payments gateway expired; no team owned its renewal. The database failover was a separate event on Oct 7. Security policy SEC-12: certificate expiry alerts must fire 30 days before expiry.

speaker: Rosa
text: Thanks for joining. This is the postmortem for INC-77, the checkout outage on October 14.

speaker: Rosa
text: Goal today is a timeline, root cause, and action items. No blame.

speaker: Omar
text: So errors started at 9:12 UTC and we recovered at 9:58.

speaker: Kenji
text: About forty-five minutes of impact, give or take.

speaker: Rosa
text: How many customers were affected?

speaker: Kenji
text: Around three thousand failed checkouts.

speaker: Rosa
text: And when did the alert fire?

speaker: Omar
text: Pretty much immediately, 9:12.

speaker: Lena
text: Hm, I remember the page coming later than that.

speaker: Rosa
text: Okay, let's note that. When was it acknowledged?

speaker: Omar
text: I acked it at 9:31, I was in another meeting.

speaker: Rosa
text: Root cause. Lena, you dug into this?

speaker: Lena
text: Yes. The internal payments gateway's TLS cert expired. Nobody owned the renewal.

speaker: Kenji
text: Wait, wasn't it the database failover?

speaker: Lena
text: No, the failover was the week before. This was the cert.

speaker: Omar
text: Funny, my home router's cert expired last month too.

speaker: Kenji
text: Oh, mine nags me constantly about firmware updates.

speaker: Omar
text: I finally replaced mine with a mesh setup, coverage is way better.

speaker: Kenji
text: Which brand? I've been thinking about getting one.

speaker: Omar
text: I'll send you a link, the setup app is great.

speaker: Rosa
text: Let's keep going. Why didn't we catch the expiry earlier?

speaker: Lena
text: We have no expiry monitoring for internal certs at all.

speaker: Rosa
text: Do we know how many other internal certs expire this quarter?

speaker: Omar
text: No idea.

speaker: Rosa
text: Okay, action items.

speaker: Kenji
text: Before that, what was the exact duration? I need it for the report.

speaker: Rosa
text: Hmm, someone can check later.

speaker: Lena
text: I can take automating the renewal.

speaker: Omar
text: And I'll add an expiry alert, maybe a week before?

speaker: Kenji
text: Sounds good.

speaker: Rosa
text: Kuuki, when exactly did the alert fire? I want it in the doc.

speaker: Rosa
text: Great. Anything else?

speaker: Kenji
text: Should we also tell the customers whose checkout failed?

speaker: Lena
text: Maybe. Let's take it offline.

speaker: Rosa
text: Okay, I think we're done. Thanks all.
